posts.name: Osmium Codes
posts.cooked:
Hey n8n builders!

we’re Osmium, a newly launched marketplace for reusable software capabilities, AI systems, APIs, and automation tools.

We’re inviting 20 independent developers and automation creators to join our founding vendor cohort.

Who we’re looking for:

  • n8n builders with original, reusable automation solutions

  • AI agent and workflow developers

  • API and backend integration creators

  • Independent developers with working software they’d like to monetize

What we’re offering:

  • An additional channel to sell your existing work

  • Freedom to set your own prices

  • Ownership of your original software

  • Personal onboarding assistance

  • Opportunities to showcase available testing evidence

This is an independent vendor opportunity, not salaried employment. Earnings depend on actual sales, and we cannot guarantee customers.

If you’ve built something reusable, we’d love to explore bringing it to Osmium.

Interested? Email: heythere@osmiumcodes.com

Subject: Osmium Founding Vendor

Tell us what you’ve built and share a demo or portfolio if available.

Looking forward to meeting some brilliant builders!

posts.name: Meir Mizrahi
posts.cooked:
Hi ZX, nice to meet you, and your agent

Right now I’m building a full travel insurance flow on WhatsApp for a client, an insurance agency. For the same client I built their sales platform, which runs there today. Employees verify with an SMS code, pay on a hosted page and get the policy by email. If a card is declined, they get an email and an SMS with a link back, and a WhatsApp message after the third try.

On my own site, offart.space/preview, there’s a chat that answers from the site’s content, replies in the visitor’s language and hands off to WhatsApp when someone wants a person.

Happy to send you a price in a DM.

I’m in Thailand, GMT+7.

Have a lovely day,
Meir

posts.name: ENDIGITA AGENCY
posts.cooked: Hi! I build n8n automations and AI agents for small businesses — lead capture, document processing, support triage — and most of our workflows are already built as reusable templates, so a marketplace model fits us well. I’d love to apply for the founding vendor cohort. Happy to share a couple of concrete examples. More about me: https://endigita.com

posts.name: Shital Katre
posts.cooked:
ENTERPRISE-GRADE INFRASTRUCTURE FOR FOUNDING NODES

Hi Team Osmium (@osmiumc ),

If you are looking to build a resilient automation framework that transitions from loose prototypes to bulletproof production systems, handling probabilistic tool outputs and avoiding transaction-level data drops is your absolute core bottleneck. Brittle workflows collapse under heavy traffic bursts.

At OmniEngine AI Studio, I design and deploy crash-proof n8n self-hosted instances and multi-agent backend configurations from first principles.

How I would structurally secure and architect Osmium’s automation layer as a Founding Creator:
Ingestion Scalability: Expert in setting up containerized Docker clusters that natively ingest and process over 1.2M+ daily external webhook payload vectors under extreme concurrent traffic peaks with absolute zero data drops.
2. Atomics & Idempotency: To permanently eliminate database race conditions and duplicate mutations when multiple n8n nodes or tools execute in parallel, I deploy native Redis lock primitives (INCR + TTL gates) directly within data paths in under 45ms.
Schema Hardening: I wrap non-deterministic LLM tool outputs inside rigid, hardcoded Pydantic schemas and validation layers to guarantee 100% structural integrity before any data commits hit production databases.

You can directly audit the exact code quality and node schema layouts of my live configurations straight from my repository:
GitHub - katreshital11-commits/ai-n8n-automation: “Production-ready and test-proven n8n AI workflows, automated CRM pipelines, and custom AI Agent architectures.”

Let’s skip the boilerplate introductory cycles—drop a broken API integration tier or a 3-day practical trial task from your active sprint backlog my way today. I will deliver a clean, merge-ready JSON configuration or Python asset back to your repo within 24 hours.

Excited to explore what we can build at Osmium!

link_counts.title: GitHub - katreshital11-commits/ai-n8n-automation: "Production-ready and test-proven n8n AI workflows, automated CRM pipelines, and custom AI Agent architectures." · GitHub

posts.name: Gilbert
posts.cooked:
I specialize in creating n8n automations that can integrate various APIs and services. For your marketplace, I could develop reusable workflows that trigger based on specific events, process data through various steps, and handle errors with clear logging and fallback options. Deliverables would include the workflow JSON files, setup documentation, and any necessary scripts. If there are specific functionalities or integrations you have in mind, please let me know for further clarification.

Gilbert, GL Tools (Vienna, written communication)

Hey @osmiumc , interesting timing for a marketplace like this, and the founding cohort idea is smart. One bit of friendly feedback from the builder side, since the thing that will decide whether strong creators list with you is not the pitch, it is the terms you have not mentioned yet. The developers worth recruiting have been burned by vague marketplace deals before, so the faster you put the specifics on the table, the faster you will get quality applications instead of just interest.

The questions I would want answered before uploading anything are, first, the economics: what is your take rate on each sale, how and when do payouts happen, and is there any listing or onboarding fee. Second, licensing and IP: you say creators keep ownership, which is great, but is a sale a single use license, a per seat license, or unlimited redistribution, and can the same workflow be listed elsewhere at the same time or are you asking for exclusivity. Third, and this is the big one for a brand new marketplace, demand: where is the buyer traffic coming from, because freedom to set my own price means little if there are no customers in front of it, and since you were honest that you cannot guarantee sales, anything concrete about how you plan to drive buyers would move the needle a lot.

Two more that matter once real money changes hands: how are refunds and buyer disputes handled, since a reusable workflow can break when someone else’s API changes through no fault of the creator, and what support burden falls on the creator after a sale versus on you. Spelling those out up front signals you have thought past launch day, and that is exactly what makes a serious builder comfortable being a founding vendor rather than waiting to see if you are still around in six months.

Full disclosure, I’m affiliated with Pond AI, so this next bit comes with my cards on the table. We build, run and maintain custom AI agents, so if at launch you ever want a few flagship reference automations to seed the marketplace, or an internal agent to handle vendor onboarding and listing review, we are happy to map that out for you first as a free architecture blueprint that is yours to keep whether you build it in house, hand it to one of your founding vendors, or have us do it. And if you did decide to have us build it, it runs with a 7 day money back refund

To seed a marketplace cold, are you also planning to commission a handful of flagship reference automations yourselves at launch, or is it entirely creator supplied to start?

posts.name: Anatolii Bilyi
posts.cooked:
Hi,

I’m interested in joining your founding vendor cohort.

I’m particularly interested in building and monetizing reusable n8n workflows, AI-powered automation systems, and API integrations that solve real business problems and can be deployed across multiple use cases.

I’d love to learn more about your onboarding process and how vendors can showcase, test, and monetize their solutions on Osmium.

I also have relevant technical work I’d be happy to demonstrate privately, including the workflow architecture, integration approach, and potential for reuse.

Let’s connect..
